newsitem.title: USA: Mednet MPC files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Mednet MPC files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Mednet MPC Corp, which was recently delisted from the Nasdaq small cap market, said it and two subsidiaries filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Nevada.
The company said in a statement that the filing will enable it to conduct its mail service pharmacy businesses under Bankruptcy Court protection while they reorganize.
The Medi-Claim presicription management service, however, wil be discontinued effective August 1, 1997.
The company was not immediately available for further comment.
